name: Summer Teen Program: Junior Zoo Keepers and Junior Camp Educators
what_you_do: High school teens spend the summer working with the zoo as Junior Zoo Keepers or Junior Camp Educators. Learn about animal care or teach kids at zoo camps.
who_can_apply: Grades 9 to 12 for the high school tracks (the program also has a middle school track for grades 6 to 8). There is an application and one or two interviews.
pay_detail: Tuition based. The amount is not stated on the page. There is also a $25 application fee that is not refunded.
deadline_text: Applications open February 1 to February 10, 2027. No late applications. The program runs June 1 to August 8, 2027.
how_to_apply: Pay the $25 application fee while the window is open. Then fill out the online form. Then interview. High school applicants may have 2 interviews.
notes: The zoo calls the program very hard to get into. It also runs a winter session that is open to new applicants. Applications are September 1 to 10, 2026. The program runs November 14, 2026 to February 14, 2027. Contact: 719-424-7822.
